name: Lan Mouse
author: Matthew Elgert
description: Software KVM switch control for the Omarchy bar: install, diagnose, and run the Lan Mouse keyboard and mouse sharing daemon on Hyprland/Wayland.

barWidget.description: Share one keyboard and mouse across computers on your LAN. Health checks for package, config, UFW rule, and daemon.

schema.label: Allowed subnet (CIDR)
schema.description: Use auto to detect the LAN on the default-route interface, or specify an IPv4 CIDR such as 192.168.1.0/24.

schema.label: Lan Mouse port
schema.description: UDP port the daemon listens on.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the health check runs while the panel is closed.

schema.label: Restore the daemon at login
schema.description: Start the daemon again at login when the switch was last left on.
